From: Ethan Park <ethan@redwood.com>

Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-09T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal: modular retainer for Q3 brand photography & event activations

Hi Sarah —

Quick note to kick off the renewal conversation for our brand photography + event activation work. Our current retainer with Lumen runs through the end of June; we want to move to a modular retainer that gives us: a) up to 8 shooting days per quarter, b) two event activation days per quarter (onsite build + wrap), and c) a per-day overage rate that is capped.

Key asks from Redwood:
- Cap day rate for senior photographer & lead producer to $2,200/day each.
- Add a sprint-based optional add-on for last-minute activations (48–72 hour turnaround) with a 1.5x multiplier.
- Add KPIs for photo deliverable turnaround (final selects within 10 business days) and 90% on-time delivery for event assets.

Could you send an updated SOW and rate sheet that reflects modular blocks (shoot day / event activation / rush) and flag any items that would need a price change? Attaching the current redlines and our Q3 budget tab so you can see expected volume.

Attachments: Lumen_SOW_v1.pdf (current), Budget_Q3_activation_tab.csv

Thanks — can we target a revised SOW by EOD Wednesday so legal can review early next week?

Cheers,
Ethan Park
Sr. Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
ethan@redwood.com
From: Sarah Lin <sarah@lumencreative.com>
To: Ethan Park <ethan@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-09T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: modular retainer for Q3 brand photography & event activations

Hi Ethan —

Thanks for the clear asks. We can absolutely move to a modular retainer structure. Notes from our side:
- Senior photographer day rate: currently $2,400/day. We can hold to $2,200/day if Redwood commits to a 3-month minimum of 6 shoot days per quarter (your budget sheet shows ~7, so that should work).
- Lead producer day rate: we can do $2,200/day but would need a 6% uplift if more than 12 producer days are used in the quarter.
- Rush add-on: 1.5x is fine for edits; for on-site rush staffing we charge 1.75x.
- Turnaround KPI: we can agree to 10 business days for final selects; we will include an SLA credit structure for missed SLAs (discount on next invoice).

I've attached an updated SOW with our proposed redlines and a new ratecard (Press_Photo_Ratecard_2027.xlsx). A couple of clarifying Qs:
1) For event activation "build + wrap" days, do you anticipate the producer to be on-site both days or can they be remote for wrap?
2) For licensing: do you want global perpetual use with exclusive rights for paid campaigns or a standard year-long buyout?

If those two items are clarified we can produce a clean SOW + DocuSign route by Monday.

Best,
Sarah Lin
Head of Production | Lumen Creative
sarah@lumencreative.com
Attachments: Lumen_SOW_v2_redlines.pdf, Press_Photo_Ratecard_2027.xlsx

Could you confirm: are we comfortable with a 3-month minimum commit (6 days/quarter) to lock $2,200/day for the senior shooter? Also, can you advise on the licensing preference — marketing typically wants global perpetual for hero assets; legal may push back on exclusivity.

Thanks for the ping and for pulling together the summary. My thoughts:
- Approve the 3-month minimum (6 days/quarter) to secure $2,200/day for senior photographer. Our forecast supports it and the math is favorable vs ad-hoc vendor day rates.
- Push back on the 1.75x for on-site rush. Ask Lumen to cap on-site emergency multiplier at 1.5x for up to 2 days per quarter; beyond that, we can reassess.
- Licensing: marketing wants global perpetual for hero campaign stills. Legal will accept non-exclusive global perpetual for campaign use only (paid media + owned channels) with a standard add-on fee for exclusive buys.
- Add KPIs and a simple SLA credit: 5% credit on the next invoice for missed delivery SLA (more than 10 business days).

Please confirm with Sarah the updates above and ask Contracts to push draft to DocuSign after Lumen acknowledges. Also include the Q3 budget tab so they can see expected usage.

Hi Sarah / Contracts —

Thanks for the quick turnaround on the draft. Confirming Redwood's agreement to the following points so you can update the SOW and route to DocuSign:
1) Modular retainer with blocks: shoot day, event activation day, rush block.
2) Senior photographer day rate locked at $2,200/day with Redwood committing to a 3-month minimum of 6 shoot days/quarter.
3) Lead producer day rate $2,200/day; 6% uplift if producer days exceed 12 in a quarter.
4) On-site rush staffing capped at 1.5x for up to 2 days/quarter; beyond that, Lumen must notify and seek approval.
5) Licensing: non-exclusive global perpetual for campaign + owned media; exclusive buyouts handled as add-ons.
6) SLA: final selects within 10 business days; 5% credit on next invoice for missed SLA.

Attached: consolidated redlines (Lumen_SOW_v2_redlines.pdf) and our Budget_Q3_activation_tab.csv for reference. Please prepare a clean SOW and send via DocuSign (link preferred) — target to have fully executed by Friday 2027-05-14 so shoots can be booked for early July.

Thanks all — feel free to loop in Contracts directly on the DocuSign link when ready.

Best,
Ethan Park
